title: Microsoft says state-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, have added AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their arsenals (Jonathan Greig/The Record)
summary: Jonathan Greig / The Record: Microsoft says state-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea, including Salt Typhoon, have added AI penetration testing tool ARTEX to their arsenals — State-backed hacking groups in China and North Korea are using a powerful AI hacking tool in attacks, according to a new report from Microsoft.
